ladder.because: the Go compiler refuses a reference to an unexported (lowercase) identifier from outside the package that declares it

rungs.fact: the protected identifier is unexported, so the compiler refuses any reference from outside its package, and every reference inside the package is inside the chokepoint

rungs.enforcer: Coherence's check at the edit and in CI
rungs.fact: the identifier is exported and reachable from any importing package; every reference gopls reports in the module is inside the chokepoint

rules.detects: the func main of a file in package main, which runs when the command starts: main.go at the module's root, cmd/<name>/main.go, or any other command's folder
a handler registered on a net/http ServeMux with a pattern: http.HandleFunc("/path", handler), mux.Handle("GET /rows/{id}", h), or a router of the same shape (gorilla/mux's HandleFunc)
a handler a router's method route names, r.GET("/path", handler) (gin, echo) or r.Get("/path", handler) (chi, fiber), in a file that imports that router
a func under an //export Name comment, which C code calls by that name

entrances.notDetected: a handler written inline as a func literal or built by a call from other values (http.FileServer(dir)), a route a helper registers with a pattern it is handed, a router of another framework, a gRPC service (Register…Server), a message consumer, a cloud function (lambda.Start) and an init func are not detected
